result.note: A brief WTO dispute item; tests the type of measure and that this was India's fourth such challenge.

questions.prompt: In August 2026, India took a United States trade measure to the World Trade Organization (WTO). Consider the following statements about this dispute:
items: The measure challenged was a safeguard tariff on quartz surfaces.
It was the first such challenge India had brought against the United States.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: India challenged a US safeguard tariff on quartz surfaces, so statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is wrong because the story describes this as India's fourth such challenge, not its first.
questions.source: India took a US quartz-surface safeguard tariff to the WTO, its fourth such challenge.
